jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
HCLTech
is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.
Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.
We are looking for Frontend Developers to join our team!
Overview:
We oversee a high-frequency, low-latency Order and Execution Management system, supporting Private Bank business lines across multiple regions.
Job Requirements:
Frontend Tech Stack: Hands-on knowledge in developing Single Page Applications (SPAs) using Angular, and TypeScript. Strong experience in responsive design, web accessibility (a11y), and CSS3/SCSS (Bootstrap 4+).
Junit/ Unit Testing: Proven experience in consuming and developing Node.js REST services, as well as unit testing with Karma/Jasmine or Jest.
Strong analytical skills;
Desire and ability to learn, debug and investigate across complex system landscape;
Demonstrable SW Development experience;
Excellent analytical and communication skills, strong independence and initiative, ability to work in agile delivery teams;
In-depth understanding of software quality and maintainability, including participation in QA automation process;
Excellent communication skills in English.
Nice to have:
Experience with React framework
Experience with GitHub workflows
Knowledge of UX design and work with Figma
Why Us?
We are investing in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark;
We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility;
Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities;
We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe;
We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees;
We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 25 countries including Romania, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect;
What do we offer?
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will benefit either a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
HCLTech is committed to protecting and securing the privacy and confidentiality of the Personal Data which it collects directly or indirectly from you when applying for a job at HCLTech either directly or through a third-party human resources agency. This notice (the “Notice”) outlines and explains how HCL Technologies Limited including its subsidiaries, local employing entities, associates, and affiliated companies [collectively referred to as “HCLTech”, “us,” “our”, or “we”] will process your Personal Data in accordance with applicable privacy legislation(s).

jobs.title: Frontend Developer - DealWise @ING Hubs Romania
jobs.description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING's software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Here's a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:
At ING, we're building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agree
The Mission
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in web components and JavaScript frameworks to join our dynamic team. As a Frontend Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing user interfaces for our web applications. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in frontend development, a deep understanding of web technologies, and a passion for creating seamless and visually appealing user experiences.
Your day to day
Frontend Development & Web Components
Develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable frontend applications.
Build modular Web Components using technologies such as Lit and modern JavaScript frameworks.
Translate UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality user interfaces.
Contribute to shared component libraries and frontend standards.
Promote coding best practices, maintainability, and consistency across applications.
Microfrontend Architecture
Design, develop, and maintain solutions within a microfrontend architecture.
Ensure seamless integration between independently developed frontend applications.
Support modularization, scalability, and independent delivery of frontend capabilities.
Contribute to frontend architecture evolution and technical decision-making.
State Management
Implement and maintain scalable state management solutions using Redux or similar technologies.
Define effective patterns for data flow and asynchronous operations.
Ensure predictable application behavior and maintainable state structures.
Support communication across frontend modules and applications.
Accessibility & User Experience
Develop accessible user interfaces that comply with WCAG and WAI-ARIA guidelines.
Perform accessibility reviews and remediation activities.
Ensure compatibility with assistive technologies.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessibility best practices.
Performance Optimization
Optimize application performance and loading times.
Identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks, memory issues, and performance concerns.
Improve Core Web Vitals and overall user experience.
Continuously monitor and enhance frontend performance.
Testing & Quality Engineering
Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Collaborate with QA engineers to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Support automated testing practices.
Participate in code reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
Azure DevOps & CI/CD
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, testing, quality validation, and deployment processes.
Manage source control, build pipelines, release workflows, and artifacts.
Support deployment and release activities across multiple environments.
Troubleshoot build and deployment issues and drive continuous improvement of delivery processes.
AI-Assisted Development
Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered engineering assistants to improve productivity.
Use AI-assisted development techniques for coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Validate and review AI-generated outputs to ensure compliance with quality, security, and maintainability standards.
Contribute to the adoption of responsible AI-assisted development practices within the team.
Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Collaborate with developers, architects, designers, product owners, and QA engineers.
Participate in architectural discussions and technical design reviews.
Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities and best practices.
Support junior and mid-level engineers through mentoring and technical guidance.
Promote a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
What you'll bring to the team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience developing modern frontend applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Hands-on experience with Lit, React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
Strong experience building and maintaining Web Components.
Solid experience with Redux or similar state management solutions.
Experience working within microfrontend architectures.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
Experience implementing accessibility standards (WCAG, WAI-ARIA).
Experience with frontend testing frameworks and automated testing practices.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Adobe Analytics
Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools.
Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization techniques.
Experience with Git-based development workflows.
If you have a passion for building innovative and user-friendly interfaces using the latest web technologies, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of our web applications and providing users with exceptional digital experiences.
If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).

who loves building interfaces that are both beautiful and data-rich: from reusable JavaScript components and design systems to interactive graph networks and data visualizations with D3.

jobs.title: Frontend Software Developer
jobs.description:
Who We Are
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
About This Role
We are seeking a Frontend Software Developer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team within Software & Product Infrastructure. This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining modern, scalable and user-centric web applications using contemporary front-end frameworks, with a particular focus on React and Angular. The successful candidate will work across multiple applications built on different technology stacks, collaborating closely with designers, backend engineers, product teams and clients to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
In addition to software development responsibilities, the role provides technical consultancy and guidance to stakeholders, helping them make informed decisions regarding technologies, solution design and product roadmaps while ensuring high standards of usability, accessibility, performance and maintainability.
What You’ll Do
Develop responsive, accessible and high-quality user interfaces using modern front-end frameworks, including React and Angular
Create clean, maintainable and efficient code that aligns with business requirements and design specifications
Work across multiple applications and adapt to different front-end frameworks, architectures and development standards
Collaborate with designers to transform wireframes and design concepts into engaging, user-friendly web experiences
Ensure consistent functionality and user experience across devices, browsers and screen sizes
Partner with backend developers to integrate front-end components with APIs and server-side services
Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with project objectives and timelines
Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance
Conduct peer code reviews and support quality assurance activities to maintain development standards
Troubleshoot, debug and resolve technical issues efficiently
Implement front-end optimisation techniques, including lazy loading, caching and performance improvements
Promote engineering best practices including version control, continuous integration and code review processes
Create and maintain technical documentation, component libraries, development guides and user-facing documentation
Explore emerging technologies, frameworks and tools, sharing knowledge with colleagues to support innovation and continuous improvement
Provide technical consultancy to clients on technology choices, development methodologies and solution roadmaps
Build strong stakeholder relationships through proactive communication, problem solving and delivery excellence
Gather client feedback, provide project updates and support alignment between technical delivery and business objectives
Contribute to onboarding activities and knowledge-transfer sessions for new team members
Promote knowledge sharing through documentation, mentoring and collaborative working practices
Contribute to departmental initiatives, strategic projects, process improvements and cross-functional activities
Who You Are
Minimum 3 years of experience in front-end development using modern JavaScript frameworks
Proven hands-on experience working with both React and Angular in production environments
Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript
Experience working with front-end build tools and package management solutions
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL integrations
Strong understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web accessibility principles
Experience with version control systems and software build tools
Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies within collaborative delivery environments
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced environment
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Commitment to continuous learning and professional development
Experience with state management libraries would be beneficial
Knowledge of server-side rendering frameworks would be advantageous
Familiarity with front-end testing frameworks is desirable
Basic understanding of UI/UX principles and usability best practices
Experience with CSS preprocessors such as SASS or LESS, or CSS-in-JS approaches, would be beneficial
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure would be advantageous
Not a perfect fit?
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
What Skills You Will Learn
Advanced frontend architecture and design patterns across React and Angular ecosystems
Enterprise-scale application development and integration practices
Performance optimisation, accessibility and responsive design techniques
API integration and collaboration within microservices-based environments
Technical consultancy, stakeholder engagement and client advisory skills
Modern DevOps, CI/CD and cloud-enabled development practices
Knowledge-sharing, mentoring and technical leadership capabilities
VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
Join Us
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET, React) IRC307903
jobs.description:
Description
Our client is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. It collects blanket license fees from businesses that use music, entitling those businesses to play or sync any songs from the client’s repertoire of over 22.4 million musical works. On a regular basis, the client distributes the money to songwriters, composers, and music publishers as royalties to those members whose works have been performed.
Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent industry experience.
Experience & Technical Focus
Core Full Stack Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing end-to-end web applications utilizing modern multi-tier design patterns and frameworks (e.g., MVC, Entity Framework).
C# & Backend Development:
5 years of Object-Oriented development experience.
5 years of C# project implementation experience (additional experience is strongly preferred).
Strong hands-on expertise in developing C# server-side, multi-threaded services and deep knowledge of the .NET framework utilizing Visual Studio.
UI & Frontend Development:
Strong professional experience with React (core requirement for this role).
Preferred experience with MUI (Material UI) or similar UI component frameworks.
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript.
Database Experience:
Strong relational database experience with a focus on PostgreSQL (MS SQL experience is also highly valued).
Repositories, Protocols & Platforms:
Proven experience with Git repositories (knowledge of industry-standard source control systems; Team Foundation Server/VSTS/Azure DevOps is a plus).
Deep understanding of industry-standard communication protocols including REST, JSON, XML.
Experience working with AWS cloud environments is preferred.
Strong experience working within Agile software development methodologies.
Skills And Abilities
Autonomy & Pace: Must possess the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Collaboration: Must be a self-motivated team player who understands the importance of teamwork, collaboration, and open communication, including a willingness to occasionally work in a pair-programming environment.
Artifact Creation: Must possess the ability to create and maintain technical artifacts including use cases, data flow charts, process flow diagrams, software requirements documents, and functional specifications documents.
Problem Solving: Must possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Communication: Must possess the ability to effectively present technical information and respond to questions from both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Best Practices: Must have an excellent understanding and hands-on experience with design and development best practices, detail orientation, and strong attention to detail.

jobs.title: JavaScript Architect
jobs.description:
Role Summary
As a JavaScript Architect at Eeze Ltd, you will define, own, and drive the high-level technical vision of our front-end ecosystem across multiple products, platforms, and teams in the gaming industry. You will collaborate closely with JavaScript Tech Leads, Product Owners, the Head of Engineering, and the CTO to ensure our architecture, technology stack, and development practices are modern, scalable, and aligned with long-term business goals.
You will act as the primary point of contact for all high-level front-end technical discussions, designs, and decisions, working outside the day-to-day sprint delivery while maintaining deep, hands-on technical expertise. Your role is to design robust, performant, and maintainable architectures, guide development workflows, and ensure that all front-end applications and games meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
This is a senior-level role for an engineer with exceptional technical depth, proven architectural experience, and strong leadership in shaping large-scale front-end systems - ideally with a background in gaming or iGaming.
Key Responsibilities
Define, maintain, and evolve the overarching front-end architecture, ensuring modularity, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Collaborate closely with JavaScript Tech Leads to translate the architectural vision into actionable plans and ensure consistent execution across teams.
Act as the company-wide point of contact for front-end technical strategy, design decisions, and high-impact features.
Partner with Product Owners to provide accurate technical estimations, development plans, risk assessments, and documentation for large-scale initiatives.
Work with the Head of Engineering and CTO to align architecture, practices, and tooling with business and long-term technical goals.
Evaluate and introduce new technologies, patterns, and frameworks that improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience.
Establish and refine coding standards, workflows, and architectural guidelines to ensure consistency across multiple teams and projects.
Perform architecture reviews, provide technical guidance, and ensure code quality, performance, and security standards are met.
Drive innovation and experimentation while balancing the need for stability and maintainability.
Required Skills
8+ years of professional experience in JavaScript/TypeScript development, including 3+ years in an architect or principal engineer role.
Proven track record in designing complex, large-scale front-end architectures (monorepos, module federation, dynamic configuration, micro-frontends).
Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, state management libraries (Redux, Zustand), and modern build tools (Vite, ESBuild).
Strong foundation in software engineering principles (SOLID, DRY, YAGNI) and functional programming paradigms.
Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives and aligning multiple stakeholders.
Exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating architectural concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
In-depth knowledge of version control and CI/CD workflows (Git, GitLab).
Experience with Agile methodologies.
Nice To Have
Experience in the iGaming or gaming industries.
Familiarity with real-time communication protocols (WebSockets, SSE), binary data handling, and video stream synchronization.
What's In It For You
Experience a dynamic and team-orientated work environment.
Opportunities for personal growth and learning.
An open, inclusive and supportive team where you will be valued, and your suggestions will be welcome.
24 days paid holiday per year. This is in addition to local public holidays.
Hybrid Working with flexi start time (2 days office/3 days home).
Private Medical Insurance.
Team Building Opportunities.
Meal Coupons provided.
Parking (limited).
Our team is committed to keeping remuneration and benefits under constant review to make sure what we offer stays relevant.
